test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47fc55d1448a4e304a2615e2edcf078e2c0d6f8d74bc2a848a79ef83d6e78800.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) HEC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb88af5893bab0c64ccf9aa7f3143b04890577bccc38873262d32f936c64a990.png] 

Option 2) **DBY**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8809d5cf4444b1395e35e9063d263e0087dce37b9a98d9b25f50e57d5cddf361.png] 

Option 3) ZWU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd2b293c08bb988809b6e06785a2a36d1785a51af50f5e0555197b6bb92b792b.png] 

Option 4) EBZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f1f8e2977b8eacd135f433a3c0621325386b8f289b471e708d31dd53aa0851b.png] 

Here, 'DBY' is odd among the given options.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
